purpose: Boundary semantics of the LIQD Dice win rule, probed against the operator's own verifier. Decides whether the band is inclusive-both-ends [lower, upper] (the model this audit originally used) or half-open [lower, upper). No bet was placed; the endpoint is read-only and was called with an already-revealed server seed from the dataset at an unused nonce.
capturedVia: browser session, logged in on qa.liqd.com

inputs.serverSeedProvenance: epoch 0 of data/dice-master-6700bets.json, revealed on rotation during the 2026-08-27 capture
inputs.nonceNote: outside the settled range 0..49 for this epoch, so the probe roll is not a settled bet

probes.meaning: roll == upper, non-inverted: LOSS -> upper bound EXCLUSIVE
roll == lower, non-inverted: WIN -> lower bound INCLUSIVE
roll == upper, inverted: WIN -> the complement gains the excluded upper point
roll == lower, inverted: LOSS -> the complement loses the included lower point
over band, roll == lower: WIN (lower inclusive holds for over)

settledBetCrossCheck.purpose: ties the verifier to the settlement engine on real money
settledBetCrossCheck.note: the verifier's multiplier equals the credited multiplier of the settled bet at full precision

conclusion: The win rule is half-open: win iff roll >= lower AND roll < upper; inverted takes the exact complement. ALL SEVEN PROBES ARE CONSISTENT WITH IT, BUT ONLY PROBES 1 AND 5 DISTINGUISH IT FROM INCLUSIVE-BOTH-ENDS. Probes 2, 3, 4, 6 and 7 return the same outcome under either rule, so they are controls, not discriminators: probe 1 (roll == upper, non-inverted, LOSS) and probe 5 (roll == upper, inverted, WIN) are the whole of the discriminating evidence, and both turn on the same single event, a roll landing exactly on an upper bound. The half-open rule also reproduces all 6,700 settled win flags in the dataset, including the two bets that landed exactly on a LOWER bound (roll 0.00 winning under [0, 94.69]; roll 99.00 winning over [99, 100]) - but so does inclusive-both-ends, so those two settle nothing either. NO SETTLED BET EVER LANDED ON AN UPPER BOUND (P = 1/10,000 per bet; 4,106 of 6,700 bets had a reachable upper bound, expectation 0.41 hits, 0 observed), which is why the inclusive model survived settlement-level verification. Under the half-open rule every mode's winning region holds exactly 100W grid points, so the effective house edge is exactly 1.00% on every bet - the effective-edge variation this report previously stated as a finding does not exist.
multiplierNote: probe multipliers equal 99 / continuousWinChance% exactly (e.g. 99/3.62 = 27.34806629834254), confirming pricing on the continuous width is unchanged
